name: The Hunt Continues

angles.text: As a young tauren coming of age on Red Cloud Mesa, you learn to use every part of a beast for the tribe, from food to clothing and shelter. This is an essential rite of passage.
As a hunter, you learn the plains' way of the hunt: stalk beasts with purpose, take only what is needed, and never treat them as sport or trophies.

faq.answer: The tribe needs mountain cougar pelts to make clothing for its children and repair the village tents at Camp Narache. Grull Hawkwind says the hides are needed for both.
faq.q: Why does the tribe need mountain cougar pelts?

faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind offers the hunt at Camp Narache. He is a prominent hunter and the son of Chief Hawkwind, and he guides young hunters in supporting the settlement.
Mountain cougars roam the hills south of Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa.
faq.q: Where are the mountain cougars found?

faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind is the son of Chief Hawkwind, the tribal leader at Camp Narache. Grull promises to speak to his father about your deeds if you bring the needed pelts.
faq.q: What is Grull Hawkwind's connection to Chief Hawkwind?

faq.answer: Among the tauren, hunting is not sport or a search for trophies. Using a beast's hide, meat, and bone to sustain the community honors the plains and helps the tribe survive.
faq.q: What does this hunt teach about tauren tradition?

faq.answer: Mountain cougar pelts are thick and durable, suited to withstand the elements on the plains. They warm the children and help patch dwellings, so village elders prize them.
faq.q: Why are mountain cougar pelts considered highly valued?

sections.body: At Camp Narache, Grull Hawkwind sends young hunters south into the hills of Red Cloud Mesa to hunt mountain cougars. This is no search for trophies. The hunt teaches young hunters to provide for their community.
sections.title: The Purpose of the Hunt

sections.body: Camp Narache needs the pelts to make clothing for the tribe's children and mend worn hide tents. When you bring them back, the elders will be grateful for your contribution. Grull promises to tell his father, Chief Hawkwind, what you have done.
sections.title: Shelter for the Tribe

summary: Grull Hawkwind sends young hunters into the southern hills of Red Cloud Mesa for mountain cougar pelts. The hides will clothe the tribe's children and help mend its tents.
